The first session compiled 121 bases in play (10.3 s on all threads); the last, with these rows on the device, 15.

# Grown on 2026-11-17 from the same iPhone 18 Pro Max's Documents/pso_user.tsv after runs on chain ae1dd68dc11c builds (three copies of the day, each holding the earlier one's rows; the last, 4943 lines): 283 rows (1 S, 282 R, 0 C) this list did not hold, added with pso_seed.py add --drop-invalid. Left out, as on 2026-11-15: its 3 geometry-path rows, S 5d537f7630ec3671_bl3, _bg3 and _bgv (not <map key>_b library keys, which the prewarm drops).
